# Complete Dental Health LLC

> Complete Dental Health LLC is a full-service dental practice in Albany, OR offering comprehensive preventative, cosmetic, restorative, and surgical dental care with advanced technology and sedation options.

Located at 1123 Hill Street SE in Albany, OR 97322, Complete Dental Health LLC is led by Dr. Matthew Schapper and provides specialized dental services to Albany and surrounding communities including Corvallis and Springfield, Oregon. The practice emphasizes patient comfort, advanced technology including Solea laser systems, and a full range of dental specialties from routine cleanings to complex oral surgery.

## Dental Services & Specialties

- [Preventative Dentistry](https://www.albanydentalhealth.com/specialty/preventative-dentistry): Preventative dental services including cleanings, sealants, and fluoride
- [Dental Cleanings](https://www.albanydentalhealth.com/specialty/dental-cleanings): Preventative dental cleaning and hygiene services in Albany, OR
- [Cosmetic Dentistry](https://www.albanydentalhealth.com/specialty/cosmetic-dentistry): Cosmetic dentistry services including teeth whitening and smile enhancement
- [Dental Implants](https://www.albanydentalhealth.com/specialty/dental-implants): Dental implant procedures using titanium and ceramic crowns for tooth replacement
- [Oral Surgery](https://www.albanydentalhealth.com/specialty/oral-surgery): Oral surgery services including tooth extraction and wisdom teeth removal
- [Root Canals](https://www.albanydentalhealth.com/specialty/root-canals): Root canal therapy for infected tooth pulp and endodontic treatment
- [Periodontal Therapy](https://www.albanydentalhealth.com/specialty/periodontal-therapy): Treatment for gum disease, gingivitis, and periodontitis in Albany, OR
- [Oral Appliances](https://www.albanydentalhealth.com/specialty/oral-appliances): Custom oral appliances for sleep apnea, snoring, and bruxism treatment
- [Sedation Dentistry](https://www.albanydentalhealth.com/specialty/sedation-dentistry): Sedation dentistry with nitrous oxide for anxious patients in Albany, OR
